text:
mike: Heads-up — planning a small v2 cutover tonight in the 22:00 UTC change window. Plan is staged: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Goal: validate telemetry and client compatibility for the tightened response shape. Need ops eyes, release notes update, and a pinlist for older SDKs.

alice: Are we keeping v1 as a fallback during the rollout?

mike: Yes — v1 stays. Routing is via X-API-Version header. If v2 returns consistent 5xx or tail latency regresses beyond thresholds we’ll fallback to v1 for affected tenants.

sara: Telemetry checklist — I’ll add dashboards for: 5xx rate, p50 latency, p95 latency, and token-cost delta vs baseline. Need a prompt-set regression check too.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Canary scheduled: 2025-11-12T22:00:00Z. Plan: flip 10% for 10m -> evaluate -> 50% for 10m -> evaluate -> 100%. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% above baseline OR p95 > 2x baseline OR prompt-set regression > 5% absolute.

julian: Can we auto-pin older mobile SDKs to v1? We still see customers on 1.1.x.

mike: Yes — we’ll publish a pinlist. Any client with sdk_version < 1.3 will be pinned to v1 automatically during the rollout. Add that to the notes.

alice: Release notes: call out the small response-key change (embedding_meta field removed from JSON). Include a migration snippet and mention no rate-limit changes. Keep the blurb short for the release email.

sara: Ops runbook item: how to manually pin a tenant or client if we see issues. Put the curl snippet in the runbook page.

alice: Snippet for ops page:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/pins \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"clients":["mobile-sdk<1.3"], "version":"v1","expires":"2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```

ops-bot: Reminder: during the 22:00 window the deploy will require oncall in-channel + paging thresholds active. Paging policy: page if 5xx spike > 0.5% or p95 > 2x baseline. I created pager ID: pg-1753214321 and added @oncall-op.

mike: Who’s ops lead tonight for the window?

julian: I’ll take 21:30-23:30 UTC.

sara: I’ll own telemetry and will hit abort if regression seen. I’ll post a short checklist pre-flip.

mike: OK — if no objections I’ll update release notes, push the deploy-bot schedule, and publish the pinlist to the docs page. :thumbsup:

alice: +1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: [CONFIRMED] Canary created. ID cb-1753214321. I will post progress updates and the outcome of each stage in this thread.

mike: Thanks — I’ll also add a short customer-facing blurb for the status page noting compatibility and migration steps.

(Defer final signoff to this thread — ops leads and docs please confirm before 21:00 UTC.)
